_comment: A/B workload catalog. 'module' = Erlang driver (side A), 'bin' = C driver (side B). RESULT is the canonical serialization both sides must produce byte-for-byte (parity = hard gate).

loader.desc: Pure parity: parse of the same .beam (AtU8) via beam_lib (A) vs beam_file_parse (B). No performance.

atom.desc: Atom table: insert+find of N unique atoms with deterministic name a<idx>; RESULT = ordered list of names.

ets.desc: ETS: insert N keys, lookup all, delete half; RESULT = final count + sum of remaining keys.

runqueue.desc: Run queue: enqueue N processes with a mix of priorities, dequeue all. RESULT = counters. Erlang proxy: spawn N procs.

alloc.desc: Allocator: alloc/free cycles with deterministic size pattern. RESULT = ops. Metrics: allocated bytes/peak.

msg.desc: Messaging: ping-pong of N messages (mailbox enqueue/dequeue in B; 2 procs in A). RESULT = sent/received.

emu_loop.desc: Interpreter pilot: N ADD iterations (loop via CALL) in B; arithmetic tail recursion in A. RESULT = final value.
